lines.rookie:
Seoul is very old.
Its story is full of secrets.
lines.junior:
Seoul is very, very old.
Its history hides many secrets.
lines.master:
Seoul is ancient.
Its history is woven with secrets.

lines.rookie: Gunpowder for a turtle ship goes missing.
lines.junior: Gunpowder for a turtle ship disappears.
lines.master: Gunpowder meant for a turtle ship vanishes.

lines.rookie: A lifting machine will not lift.
lines.junior: A lifting machine refuses to lift.
lines.master: A lifting machine stubbornly refuses to lift.

lines.rookie: Logs for the palace go missing.
lines.junior: Logs meant for the palace disappear.
lines.master: Timber bound for the palace vanishes.

lines.rookie: And the palace lights go dark.
lines.junior: Then the palace lights go out.
lines.master: And then the palace lamps fall dark.

lines.rookie: Twelve cases, in twelve times of Seoul's story.
lines.junior: Twelve cases, set in twelve times of Seoul's story.
lines.master: Twelve cases, set in twelve different ages of Seoul's story.

lines.rookie:
Each one is a mystery
of its own.
lines.junior:
Each one is a separate mystery
with its own clues.
lines.master:
Every one is a mystery
with clues all its own.

lines.junior: What really happened, and why did it happen?
lines.master: What truly happened, and for what reason?

lines.rookie:
Every case is built on
a true story of Korea.
lines.junior:
Each case is built on
a true story of Korea.
lines.master:
Every case rests on
a true chapter of Korea's past.

lines.junior: Solve each case on its own.

lines.rookie:
Your first case starts
in old Hanyang.
lines.junior:
Your first case begins
in old Hanyang.
lines.master:
Your first case awaits
in old Hanyang.

lines.rookie: From 1446 to 1945: twelve cases, all solved.
lines.junior: From 1446 to 1945, all twelve cases are solved.
lines.master: From 1446 to 1945, every one of the twelve cases is solved.

lines.rookie: In each one, you found what really happened.
lines.junior: In each one, you found out what really happened.
lines.master: In each one, you uncovered what truly happened.

lines.rookie: Seoul keeps its story in its letters.
lines.junior: Seoul holds its story in its letters.
lines.master: Seoul preserves its story within its letters.

lines.rookie: This time, you read it case by case.
lines.junior: This time, you have read it one case at a time.
lines.master: This time, you have pieced it together case by case.
